name: Cleanup After Ceiling Finish
intent: Vacuum the floor (sub or finished), remove ceiling fixture protection, clean tools, walk the room for final inspection. Final inspect rate slows by quality tier because higher tiers demand finer defect detection on the cured ceiling finish.
doctrine: Final inspect ceiling slows from 2000 SF/hr at QT2/3 down to 800 SF/hr at QT5 because the inspector is checking for finer defects under critical lighting. Fixture protection removal only fires for spray methods. The roll scenarios don't install ceiling fixture protection so they have no protection to remove. Clean tools is a flat 20 minutes per session.
